Hanno City Gender Equality Awareness Survey 2026 (Reiwa 8)

Survey period: November 10, 2026 (Reiwa 8) at 9:00 AM to January 9, 2027 at 11:59 PM

Who can participate: Residents of Hanno City aged 18 and older

How to respond: Complete the survey online via electronic form or paper form by mail

Electronic form: https://apply.e-tumo.jp/city-hanno-saitama-u/offer/offerList_detail?tempSeq=126621

If you prefer a paper form, please contact the Human Rights, Daily Life and Safety Division. The survey is free to complete.

This survey gathers your views to help create the 7th Hanno City Gender Equality Plan. Your participation is appreciated.

Contact: Human Rights, Daily Life and Safety Division, Deshii
Phone: 042-973-2111 (extension 6201)
Email: kurashi@city.hanno.lg.jp

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-cci.or.jp/xo_event/xo_event-2887/
